purpose: Compare the exact user-designated ca2af9f8 rollback version with one plain-language object-world and audience-world attention candidate on six new cases.

candidate.description: One plain-language call compares product/object, direct use or activity, and recurring need; it selects separate object-world and audience-world candidates by id.

automatic_scorer_review.diagnosis: The boundary-safe exact matcher removed E33-E34 substring false positives but produced systematic false negatives for semantically equivalent compounds and valid alternative roots.
false_negative_examples: 家庭烘焙实践 was scored different from the frozen alias 家庭烘焙.
淡水钓鱼实践 was scored different from 淡水钓鱼.
生日庆祝与仪式 was scored different from the separately listed aliases 生日庆祝 and 生日仪式.
观赏鱼饲养与水族造景 was scored different from the listed 观赏鱼饲养 and 水族饲养 alternatives.
古籍保存与延寿需求 was a valid audience root omitted from the system-authored hidden alternatives.
宠物离世哀伤支持 and the baseline's 宠物告别与哀悼 were valid roots omitted from the system-authored hidden alternatives.
automatic_scorer_review.consequence: The frozen automatic score remains a failed preregistration. It cannot establish the business winner and is not repaired by adding aliases after the run.

cases.candidate_object_world: 观赏鱼饲养与水族造景
cases.candidate_audience_world: 观赏鱼饲养与水族造景
cases.reason: The baseline preserves the broad object world; the candidate turns it into an actionable recurring practice but combines care and aquascaping into one narrower territory.
Both reach freshwater fishing. The baseline is cleaner and already emits engines; the candidate usefully separates near-product usage from the audience's full activity.
The baseline remained contract-invalid after its shared repair. The candidate reliably moved from the tool to the complete activity it serves.
The candidate makes the intended product-to-use-to-social-practice leap; the baseline explicitly stays at the product because evidence is sparse.
The candidate distinguishes professional practice from the long-running preservation need and keeps a direct path back to restoration services.
Both are semantically sound; the candidate more clearly separates the delivered ritual from the audience's recurring emotional need and marks capability limits as unknown.

findings: No output invented user-owned material, customer cases, account results, business scale, credentials, or operating capabilities as observed facts.
Candidate-specific capability assumptions were placed in conditions or unknowns rather than asserted as user facts.
General domain claims about restoration, animal grief, fish care, and food practice would still require sourced research before becoming publishable content.

comparison_limits.baseline_unique_capabilities: ca2af9f8 also emits content engines and attention entries; the E35 candidate deliberately does not, so the candidate cannot replace the full baseline contract.
comparison_limits.heldout_labels: The six hidden labels were preregistered system hypotheses, not user-reviewed gold annotations.
comparison_limits.causal_claim: One six-case run supports a design direction, not a causal claim about all businesses or models.

retained: Move model attention from the sold noun to the complete object or activity and then to the audience's recurring need.
Keep object world and audience world separate because they may coincide or diverge.
Generate and inspect alternatives before convergence, while preserving one Lead as final decision owner.
Bind final selections to generated candidate ids and keep all user-specific capability assumptions conditional.
rejected: Treating exact Chinese phrase equality as a semantic business judge.
Changing frozen labels or rerunning E35 after seeing outputs.
Registering the E35 evaluator, schema, or candidate as a mandatory Tool, Skill, subagent, middleware stage, or Gateway path.
Replacing ca2af9f8's content engines and attention entries with a semantic-only candidate.
architecture_learning.next_boundary: Retain ca2af9f8 as the full-structure rollback baseline. If production is changed, make one minimal replacement inside its audience-world reasoning so the Lead can distinguish object world from audience world, then validate the complete answer rather than another exact-alias score.
